uncited: This method predicts 3D Gaussian primitive parameters (mean $\boldsymbol{\mu}$, covariance $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}$, opacity $\alpha$, spherical harmonics $\mathbf{S}$) from per-pixel features by modeling the depth distribution as a discrete probability density over depth buckets, rather than regressing a point estimate.

It solves the problem of local minima inherent in direct regression of Gaussian centers and enables the use of differentiable training where non-differentiable spawning/pruning heuristics from 3D-GS cannot be applied.

*   **Input:** Per-pixel feature vector $\mathbf{F}[\mathbf{u}]$ at pixel coordinate $\mathbf{u}$, camera origin $\mathbf{o}$, ray direction $\mathbf{d}_{\mathbf{u}}$, depth range $[d_{\text{near}}, d_{\text{far}}]$, and number of depth buckets $Z$.
*   **Depth Buckets $\mathbf{b} \in \mathbb{R}^Z$:** A vector representing discrete depth values in disparity space.
